comments.subject: Thank You!
comments.comment:
Dear Mayor,

Thank you for your decision to shut down public comments at the City Council meetings. Enough is enough already!

It is past time these culture warriors that take their cues from fringe television/radio programs and attempt to apply them to city council-related business.

Your decision is deeply appreciated by me and my neighbors here in Sunriver, and we will not forget how you have decisively dealt with these fringe characters whose only intent is to disrupt the business of the City.

Regards,
Mike Corcoran

comments.subject: Letter of Support
comments.comment:
Dear Mayor Randall,

I have been wanting to send you a letter for some time and just have not had the time to get to it. I can't express enough thanks to you for your recent change to public comment. I have attended 2 different City Council meetings that were dominated by public comments that seemed extremely divisive and personally uncomfortable to sit through. Our city has much larger issues to deal with than the issues that seemed to be covered during the public comment period.

I am concerned that we live in a community that has a very vocal minority that has been using public meetings to try and push their agenda. I appreciate that you, and some of the City Council, sees this and you are doing what you can to try and listen to everyone. I truly believe in the First Amendment and appreciate those that participate in government. The change to online comment does not seem to be a violation of these rights, and I believe, frees up time for you and the council to work on the larger issues you are faced with like growth, water, the downtown plan, etc.

Thank you for all that you do for the city and for truly doing what you can to represent all of St. George and not just the vocal minority.

Cheers,
Josh Sutton
